name: grain_fans
description: broad fans of alternating teal and orange bands, each band scooped darker towards its edge and carrying fine parallel grain, a bead chain of the set's lace along the edges
reuses: the smooth count through a cyclic map by rank (smooth_bands)
notes: Item 064 brought eight classic escape-time references (molemou, ovaline, touch, valhalla, underworld, under-a-brighter-sky, toxic-spire, molten) whose geometry is plain seahorse, spiral and dendrite, and whose look is their surface. No primitive was added: a texture probe at three seats found that orbit statistics already draw them. `stripe` at density 24 to 128 draws fine feathered strokes along the escape flow, decorrelating sample to sample near the set (a frost, a grain); at density 3 it swings slowly, so its troughs and crests read as cloth folds (2 still feathers). `gaussian_int` (the orbit's closest pass to the integer lattice) inverted at power 30 to 60 draws sparkle points scattered along the set (a stipple). `tia` and `curvature` draw soft plumes; `velocity` and `trap_circle` band too hard to be a texture.

The stack: the smooth count by rank at 4 cycles of a teal and orange map; a multiply sheet at 8 bands (each band scooped darker towards its far edge); `stripe` 48 twice, a dark multiply and a pale screen (the grain, running across each band as touch's does); a dark and a pale `de` hair (the bead chain); a faint `gaussian_int` sparkle. This is the feathery stroke crisis_smooth and dalooka_smooth never drew. Round one's readings: g3_fine (`stripe` 96), g3_six (6 cycles), g3_plain (no grain: the headline off).

Explorer cost (080, `style cost`, read beside other Node workers: an upper bound): 65 s as WebAssembly on one thread at 1280x800 ss2 at its deepest kept seat (julia-mandelbrot_53dd5a48, maxiter 3,000), under the 5-minute bar.
